Alok Singh — Co-Founder

Building the platform with a creator's mindset

Alok Singh is publicly credited as a Co-Founder in his GGL technology profile. His association connects the creative direction of Gorakhpur's Got Latent with the digital work that supports the platform.

GGL is a talent and entertainment platform based in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh. The show brings together performers, audiences and a growing digital presence. Alok's co-founder credit recognises his place in the team behind that wider platform.

Alok is also credited as a Show Creator alongside Naveen Varma. For the current official show information, announcements and participation details, visitors should use the GGL official website.

This page describes a public team credit; it does not claim that Alok is the sole founder or host of GGL.
